title: Sketch your view
description: Grab any pen and draw what's in front of you for 15 minutes — no erasing allowed.

title: Write a six-word story
description: Sum up your week, a dream or a stranger's life in exactly six words. Write five of them.

title: Make a mini zine
description: Fold one sheet of paper into an 8-page booklet and fill it with doodles about anything.

title: Photo walk with a theme
description: Pick a theme like "red things" or "circles" and shoot 20 photos of it around your neighbourhood.

title: Paint a kindness rock
description: Paint a tiny scene or a kind message on a smooth stone and leave it somewhere for a stranger.

title: Make a playlist for a mood
description: Build a 10-song playlist for a very specific mood, like "rainy Tuesday bus ride".

title: Blind contour portraits
description: Draw each other's faces without looking at the paper. Laughing is mandatory.

title: Write a letter to future you
description: Write a letter to open one year from now. Seal it and set a calendar reminder.

title: Fold an origami animal
description: Fold a crane, frog or jumping fox from a tutorial — any sheet cut square works.

title: Record a mini podcast
description: Pick a topic you love and record a 10-minute episode on your phone, solo or with a friend.

title: Make a magazine collage
description: Cut up old magazines or flyers and glue together a vision board or a surreal scene.

title: Film a one-minute movie
description: Shoot and edit a 60-second film on your phone. Give it a dramatic title and a premiere.

title: Design your own board game
description: Sketch rules and a board on cardboard, then play-test it with whoever is around.

title: Try hand lettering
description: Practise brush or hand lettering with a marker — your name, a quote, even a grocery list.

title: Write a song together
description: One person picks chords or a beat, the others add lyrics. Perform it, however badly.

title: Chalk art on the sidewalk
description: Buy a box of chalk and turn a patch of pavement into a mural, hopscotch or maze.

title: Make a stop-motion clip
description: Use toys, food or paper cut-outs and a free stop-motion app to animate a short scene.

title: Crochet your first coaster
description: Grab cheap yarn and a hook, follow a beginner video and make one wobbly coaster.

title: Upcycle an old T-shirt
description: Turn a shirt you never wear into a tote bag, headband or cleaning rags.

title: Draw a map of your life
description: Sketch an imaginary map where the places are memories, friends and goals.

title: Sunrise or sunset walk
description: Time a walk to catch the sky changing colour. Bonus points for a new route.

title: Picnic in the park
description: Pack simple snacks and a blanket and eat outside, even if it's just for an hour.

title: Cloud watching
description: Lie on your back and find shapes in the clouds. Name at least three.

title: Hike a new trail
description: Look up a nearby trail you've never tried, pack water and go. Take a photo at the top.

title: Go stargazing
description: Find a dark spot, let your eyes adjust for 15 minutes and spot a constellation.

title: Bike somewhere new
description: Cycle for 30 minutes in a direction you never go, then come back a different way.

title: Plant something
description: Plant herbs, flowers or a seed in a pot or garden — and give it a name.

title: Visit a farmers' market
description: Wander the stalls, try one thing you've never eaten and chat with a grower.

title: Go geocaching
description: Install a geocaching app and find a hidden cache near you.

title: Skip stones
description: Find a lake, river or pond and try to beat your record number of skips.

title: Go birdwatching
description: Sit quietly in a park for 30 minutes and identify birds with a free app.

title: Explore a new neighbourhood
description: Take a bus or train to a part of town you've never visited and just wander.

title: Fly a kite
description: Make or buy a cheap kite and get it up on a windy day.

title: Walk barefoot on grass
description: Take off your shoes and walk on grass for ten minutes. Notice every texture.

title: Park workout circuit
description: Push-ups on a bench, step-ups, sprints between trees. Fifteen minutes, done.

title: Clean up a stretch of street
description: Bring a bag and gloves and pick up litter on a street, path or beach.

title: Watch the sunrise from up high
description: Set an early alarm, climb a hill or rooftop and watch the day begin.

title: Swim outdoors
description: Find a lake, the sea or an outdoor pool and go for a swim.

title: Forage for berries
description: Learn one edible plant that grows near you, then go find it — only pick what you're sure of.

title: Camp out at home
description: Set up a tent or blanket nest in the yard or on the balcony and spend the evening outside.

title: Call an old friend
description: Ring someone you haven't spoken to in a year. No texting — a real call.

title: Host a potluck
description: Invite friends and ask everyone to bring one dish. You provide plates and music.

title: Host a game night
description: Gather people for card or board games. The loser does the dishes.

title: Write thank-you notes
description: Send three short notes or messages thanking people who helped you lately.

title: Volunteer for an afternoon
description: Find a local food bank, shelter or park clean-up that needs a hand today.

title: Go to a free local event
description: Check listings for a free talk, gig, exhibition or meetup and just go.

title: Karaoke at home
description: Pull up karaoke videos online and sing your heart out with friends.

title: Teach someone a skill
description: Show a friend something you're good at — a recipe, a trick, a game.

title: Start a photo-a-day challenge
description: Challenge friends to share one photo a day around a theme for a week.

title: Themed movie night
description: Pick a theme, dress up a little and serve matching snacks.

title: Play a sport in the park
description: Gather people for frisbee, football or volleyball.

title: Try a club or meetup
description: Find a local group for running, books, languages or chess and go once.

title: Cook dinner for someone
description: Invite a friend or neighbour over and cook them a meal.

title: Host a clothes or book swap
description: Everyone brings things they don't use and leaves with something new.

title: Go dancing
description: Find a dance class or a club night — or just dance in the kitchen with friends.

title: Video-call a faraway friend
description: Schedule a long catch-up with someone who lives in another city or country.

title: Compliment three strangers
description: Give genuine, small compliments to three people today.

title: Bowling or mini golf
description: Gather friends for a round. Keep score and trash-talk gently.

title: Plan a dream trip together
description: Sit down with friends and plan a weekend away, budget and all.

title: Do an escape room
description: Book an escape room with friends and see if you can beat the clock.

title: Learn 10 words of a new language
description: Pick a language you've never studied and learn greetings, numbers and "thank you".

title: Watch a documentary
description: Choose a topic you know nothing about and watch a documentary on it.

title: Learn to juggle
description: Start with two balls (or rolled socks), then three. Ten minutes a day works wonders.

title: Take a free online lesson
description: Pick a free course on anything — astronomy, drawing, coding — and finish lesson one.

title: Read a non-fiction chapter
description: Pick a book you've been meaning to read and finish one chapter.

title: Learn a card trick
description: Learn one magic trick from a tutorial and perform it for someone.

title: Memorize a poem
description: Choose a short poem and learn it by heart. Recite it to someone.

title: Visit a museum
description: Go to a museum or gallery and spend real time with just three pieces.

title: Learn five useful knots
description: Bowline, clove hitch, square knot, figure-eight and taut-line hitch.

title: Learn basic first aid
description: Watch a first-aid video on CPR and the recovery position, then practise the steps.

title: Watch a talk and explain it
description: Watch a short talk on a random topic, then explain it to someone in two minutes.

title: Identify five trees
description: Walk around and use a free plant-ID app to learn five trees near you.

title: Practise touch typing
description: Do 15 minutes of typing practice and try to beat your words per minute.

title: Learn three chords
description: Pick up a guitar, ukulele or keyboard app and learn three chords and one song.

title: Record a family story
description: Interview an older relative about their childhood and write down the stories.

title: Try a coding tutorial
description: Build a tiny web page or game with a free beginner tutorial.

title: Learn three constellations
description: Learn three constellations from an app, then find them outside tonight.

title: Join a trivia night
description: Join a local quiz night with a team, or play an online quiz with friends.

title: Learn a dance from a video
description: Pick salsa basics or a viral dance and nail it from a tutorial.

title: Borrow something random
description: Go to a library, browse a section you never visit and borrow something surprising.

title: Host a blind taste test
description: Buy three versions of the same snack and rank them blindfolded with friends.

title: Bake bread from scratch
description: Make a simple no-knead loaf. The smell alone is worth it.

title: Cook a dish from another country
description: Pick a country at random and cook one of its classic dishes.

title: Make homemade pizza
description: Make dough, set out toppings and let everyone build their own.

title: Try a new café or restaurant
description: Go somewhere you've never been and order the thing you can't pronounce.

title: Smoothie experiment
description: Blend three fruits and one surprise ingredient. Rate the result honestly.

title: Make fresh pasta by hand
description: Flour, eggs, a rolling pin. Cut it into ribbons and cook it straight away.

title: Pancake art breakfast
description: Draw shapes with batter in the pan — letters, animals, faces.

title: No-machine ice cream
description: Whip cream with condensed milk, stir in a flavour and freeze.

title: Street food crawl
description: Find a few food trucks or stalls and share small dishes from each.

title: Roll your own sushi
description: Rice, nori, fillings and a mat or towel. Wonky rolls still taste great.

title: Five-ingredient challenge
description: Make a tasty meal using only five ingredients.

title: Make a fancy hot chocolate
description: Melt real chocolate into milk, add spices and a mountain of cream.

title: Cook a family recipe
description: Ask a relative for a dish from your childhood and cook it.

title: Quick-pickle vegetables
description: Pickle cucumbers, onions or carrots in vinegar, sugar and salt overnight.

title: Fold dumplings together
description: Make dumplings as a group — the uglier, the better.

title: Grill outside
description: Fire up a grill and cook vegetables, sausages or skewers outdoors.

title: Make lemonade from scratch
description: Squeeze lemons, add sugar, water, ice and maybe some mint.

title: Try a fruit you've never had
description: Buy a fruit you've never tasted at the shop and try it.

title: Bake your own granola
description: Mix oats, nuts, honey and oil and bake until golden. Breakfast for the week.

title: Box-breathing break
description: Breathe in 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4. Repeat for five minutes and notice the difference.

title: Guided meditation
description: Sit comfortably and follow a 10-minute guided meditation from a free app.

title: Gentle yoga session
description: Follow a 20-minute beginner yoga video. Go slow — it's not a contest.

title: Journal three good things
description: Write down three things that went well today, and why.

title: Digital detox hour
description: Put your phone in another room for an hour. Read, think, look out the window.

title: Take a mindful walk
description: Walk slowly and notice five things you see, four you hear, three you can touch.

title: Take a long bath
description: Run a bath, add salts and relax with calm music.

title: Stretch for 15 minutes
description: Stretch every major muscle group slowly, breathing into each one.

title: Body scan before sleep
description: Lie down and slowly relax every part of your body from toes to head.

title: Sit in silence outside
description: Find a bench or patch of grass and sit without your phone for 20 minutes.

title: Brain dump on paper
description: Write every thought and to-do on paper until your head feels empty.

title: Try a sound bath
description: Lie down with headphones and listen to a singing-bowl or rain soundscape.

title: Watch the rain
description: Sit by a window with a warm drink and just watch the weather.

title: Try tai chi
description: Follow a beginner tai chi video. Slow movements, deep breaths.

title: Write a gratitude letter
description: Write — and maybe send — a letter to someone who changed your life.

title: Colour a mandala
description: Print a mandala colouring page and fill it in slowly.

title: Run without tracking
description: Go for a run with no music or apps. Just you, your breath and your feet.

title: Eat one meal mindfully
description: Eat a meal slowly, without screens, noticing every flavour.

title: Create a calm corner
description: Set up a cosy spot with a blanket, a plant and a lamp just for relaxing.

title: Shoulder massage swap
description: Trade 10-minute shoulder massages with someone you trust.

title: Play a game of chess
description: Play chess with a friend or online. New to it? Learn the moves and beat an easy bot.

title: Start a jigsaw puzzle
description: Open a 500-piece puzzle and leave it out to keep going later.

title: Play charades
description: Act out films, books and songs without speaking. Teams make it louder.

title: Solve a crossword or sudoku
description: Grab today's puzzle and see how far you get without hints.

title: Grown-up hide and seek
description: Play hide and seek in a house or park. It's still thrilling.

title: Build a blanket fort
description: Build the biggest fort you can with blankets, chairs and pillows.

title: Co-op video game evening
description: Pick a co-op or party game and play together for an evening.

title: Paper airplane contest
description: Fold different designs and see whose plane flies farthest.

title: Play a word game
description: Play Scrabble, Bananagrams or a word app with someone.

title: Set up a treasure hunt
description: Hide clues around the house or park for someone else to solve.

title: Learn a new card game
description: Learn Spit, Gin Rummy or Durak and play a few rounds.

title: Host a trivia showdown
description: Write 20 trivia questions and quiz your friends or family.

title: Two truths and a lie
description: Take turns sharing two true facts and one lie about yourself. Guess the lie.

title: Water balloon fight
description: Fill up balloons and battle it out in the yard or park.

title: Play Pictionary
description: Draw words while your team guesses against the clock.

title: Free-build with LEGO
description: Build something with no instructions — a spaceship, a city, a monster.

title: Capture the flag
description: Gather friends in a park for a classic running game.

title: Beat a solo puzzle game
description: Play a puzzle or strategy game you've never tried, from start to finish.

title: Invent a dice game
description: Make up new rules for a dice game and play-test them.

title: Table tennis or badminton
description: Find a table or a net and play a few sets.

title: Rearrange a room
description: Move the furniture around to give a room a fresh feel.

title: Declutter one drawer
description: Empty one drawer, keep only what you love, donate the rest.

title: Deep-clean one spot
description: Pick one area — the fridge, a window, the bathroom — put on a podcast and make it shine.

title: Kitchen dance party
description: Turn up a playlist and dance while you tidy.

title: Fix something broken
description: That wobbly chair or dripping tap? Watch a repair video and fix it.

title: Spa evening at home
description: Face masks, a foot soak, candles and music.

title: Repot your plants
description: Give your house plants fresh soil and roomier pots.

title: Build a bird feeder
description: Make a feeder from a bottle or pine cone with peanut butter and seeds.

title: Organize your photos
description: Sort your phone photos into albums and delete the blurry ones.

title: Living-room workout
description: Do a 20-minute bodyweight workout in your living room.

title: Make candles
description: Melt old candle stubs or wax flakes and pour new candles into jars.

title: Create a reading nook
description: Turn a corner into a cosy reading spot with cushions and a lamp.

title: Hang up art or photos
description: Print photos or pick some art and finally hang it on the wall.

title: Batch-cook for the week
description: Cook three dishes and portion them up for the days ahead.

title: Start a windowsill herb garden
description: Plant basil, mint and parsley on a sunny windowsill.

title: Movie trilogy marathon
description: Pick a trilogy and watch it all with blankets and snacks.

title: Paint a wall or old furniture
description: Give a wall, shelf or old chair a fresh coat of colour.

title: Sort your wardrobe
description: Try everything on; keep what fits and makes you happy.

title: Bake cookies for neighbours
description: Bake a batch and leave some at your neighbours' doors.

title: Plan your perfect week
description: Sit down with a calendar and plan a week with more of what you love.
